warrants.quote: Each PIPE Warrant has an exercise price of $ 9.93 per ADS and is exercisable for a three year period beginning in February 2024.
The 2025 ADS Warrants have an exercise price of $ 5.7960 per ADS and are exercisable following a specified data milestone.
The Pre-funded Warrants have an exercise price of $ 0.0001 per ADS and are exercisable immediately.
